Liz H: quick check — planning a short quiet-window this Thu 03:00-03:15 UTC to push a small quant-profile tweak (Q-2 -> Q-2b) on a subset of slabs. looking for an owner for smoke + rollback readiness. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

Ajay P: I can own smoke + rollback. will run the profile canary on 4 slices first, then expand if green.

Liz H: thx Ajay — plan is: 03:00 start, 03:00-03:05 canary (slices a-d), 03:05-03:10 expand to 8 slices, 03:10-03:15 monitor and finish. rollback trigger: >1.5x p95 latency or >2% error delta vs baseline for 5m.

Marta G: quick q — do we need a KV-cache invalidation during the swap? last time stale prefixes caused weird logits.

Ajay P: good call. we'll evict prefix cache on canary nodes only after successful profile load: `curl -X POST https://ops.internal/cache/evict -d '{"prefix":"/kv/prefix"}'` (will run from test account).

Sam R: posted CR for the profile change: https://phab/rev/PR12345 — please ping if you want a fast look. also can we add the smoke script I used yesterday? small checklist: `healthz`, `p95_latency`, `kb/s`, `error_rate`.

deploy-bot: deploy scheduled by Liz H — 3245678901 — quiet-window Thu 03:00 UTC. Owners: Ajay P (smoke/rollback), Sam R (CR), Liz H (coord).

Marta G: ack. one more: metric thresholds — can Ajay paste exact alert queries here? want to make sure dashboard panels match.

Ajay P: alert queries: `p95_latency > baseline*1.5 over 5m` and `error_rate - baseline_error > 0.02 over 5m`. will paste dashboards before EOD.

Liz H: perfect. everyone please be reachable on this thread during the window; Ajay will post step-by-step. I’ll do the final green signal before expand. cheers :thumbsup:

Sam R: will be oncall this window. I'll have quick rollback playbook ready in case.

Ajay P: will post smoke script now and share run outputs in-thread. starting preflight tomorrow 20:00 UTC to warm up.

Liz H: thank you — short and final: owner = Ajay, backup = Sam, time = Thu 03:00-03:15 UTC, rollback rules set. see you folks then.
